financings_after_balance_sheet.what: Exercise of 3,030,000 pre-funded warrants at $0.0001 per share
financings_after_balance_sheet.quote: On April 19, 2022, the Company issued 3,030,000 shares of common stock to holders of the March 7, 2022 Pre-Funded Warrants upon exercise of these warrants at an exercise price of $0.0001.

warrants.quote: The Common Warrants have an exercise price of $1.30 per share of common stock and are exercisable six months after the date of issuance and have a term of five years from the date of exercisability.
the number of shares of common stock issuable upon exercise of the Avenue Capital Warrants were set to 867,769 at an exercise price of $1.21.
The exercise price per share of the underwriter warrants is $7.50 (equal to 125% of the public offering price per share for the shares of common stock sold in the offering)
